title: Create src/lib/loop-runner.ts — core loop execution logic
description: Create the core loop runner as an async generator function. It drives the AI backend through iterations, yields typed events for the TUI to consume, and handles all exit conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: runLoop(options) is exported as an AsyncGenerator function
Yields { type: 'iteration-start', n } at the start of each iteration
Yields { type: 'output', line } for each line of AI output
Yields { type: 'complete' } when <complete> tag is detected
Yields { type: 'blocked', reason } when <blocked> tag is detected
Yields { type: 'decide', question } when <decide> tag is detected
Yields { type: 'max-reached' } when maxIterations is reached
Generator terminates (return) after any exit condition

steps.details: In loop-runner.ts: export type LoopOptions = { task: Task; backend: AgentBackend; maxIterations: number; agentDir: string }. export type LoopEvent = { type: 'iteration-start'; n: number } | { type: 'output'; line: string } | { type: 'complete' } | { type: 'blocked'; reason: string } | { type: 'decide'; question: string } | { type: 'max-reached' } | { type: 'timing'; iterationN: number; elapsedMs: number }

export async function* runLoop(options: LoopOptions): AsyncGenerator<LoopEvent> { const { task, backend, maxIterations, agentDir } = options; for (let i = 1; i <= maxIterations; i++) { yield { type: 'iteration-start', n: i }; const prompt = await buildPrompt(task, agentDir); const startMs = Date.now(); // spawn AI process and collect output... }

steps.description: Collect AI output line by line and yield events
steps.details: After spawning the backend process, read stdout line by line. For each line: yield { type: 'output', line }. Accumulate all output in a string. After process exits, check for exit tags using detectComplete/detectBlocked/detectDecide.

steps.description: Handle exit conditions and terminate generator
steps.details: After each iteration's output is accumulated: if (detectComplete(output)) { yield { type: 'complete' }; return } if (detectBlocked(output)) { yield { type: 'blocked', reason }; return } if (detectDecide(output)) { yield { type: 'decide', question }; return }. After the for loop: yield { type: 'max-reached' }

steps.description: Yield timing event after each iteration
steps.details: After each iteration's output is processed (before checking exit conditions): const elapsedMs = Date.now() - startMs; yield { type: 'timing', iterationN: i, elapsedMs }

technicalNotes: AsyncGenerator is the correct TypeScript type for async generator functions — function* with yield
Reading stdout line by line: use readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdout }) on the child process
The generator pattern allows the TUI to consume events incrementally without callbacks
